label: Finite models for the modal-principle branches of the NECESSARY_2 sense fork
paraphrase: Formal controls: (1) nonvacuity: on a one-point universal frame the T, 4, B and 5 schemas are valid, the K node holds and each of the four fork theorems' conclusions holds on its reading; (2) one omission model per load-bearing premise: without the T schema (non-reflexive two-world frame), the 4 schema (reflexive non-transitive chain), the B or 5 schema (two worlds ordered false <= true), the reading choice (every sense intended) or the K node (the being exists nowhere), the fork node fails while the other premises hold; (3) the two recorded rivals are exactly negated: NoDistinctNecessaryPotentialCausers iff not modal ditheism, and the first clause of SimplicityCollapse.Core excludes NecessaryActStrictlyYieldsContingent. No model is claimed to describe reality.
